title: Chunking your content for agent readability
publisher: I’d Rather Be Writing Blog and API doc course
author: Tom Johnson
reason:
It offers practical
guidance on chunking documentation so MCP retrieval systems provide coding agents with more usable
context.
summary: This post continues my series on agent readability by looking at chunking. When docs are ingested into an MCP server or other retrieval system, a chunker splits each page into passages, and the agent often sees only those passages rather than the whole page. I walk through how ingestion works, how one chunker (Google’s Agent Search) sizes chunks in tokens, and how headings, section length, long tables, long code samples, images, procedures, and tabs hold up when a page gets chunked.
